biological_mechanism: Enable long-chain fatty-acid transport into mitochondria so fat-derived ATP production can proceed.
food_material: Beef meat samples in the primary radioisotopic composition study

food_evidence.statement: The primary food-analysis report explicitly identifies this meat among measured L-carnitine sources.

preparation: Cut and preparation unresolved in retrieved publisher text; no quantity or equivalence to cooked meals inferred
limitations: Functional dependency and food composition support Capacity, not a need to increase intake. Endogenous synthesis, tissue uptake and conservation also sustain the pool. The existing extracted carnitine/carbohydrate intervention is formulation-specific; meat or dairy effects on transport flux, brain function or ADHD are not established.

Qualitative food supply only. No carnitine amount, tissue uptake or ordinary-food intervention effect inferred. Independent verification of material/preparation is required before a canonical food edge.
